messages:
Alex: Quick bench across regions: us-west-2 (A100/H100), eu-west-1 (A100), ap-southeast-1 (H100). Focus: reranker + 768->1536-d embeddings, batch sizes 1/8/32.
Maria: nice. what's the TL;DR numbers?
Alex: TL;DR: H100 (ap-southeast-1) peak embed throughput 1536-d @ B=32 ~ 38k embeddings/s, A100 (us-west-2) ~ 14k, CPU c6i large ~ 900.
Keiko: H100 38k? that seems high for 1536 dims at B=32. did you enable tensor cores + cutlass kernels?
Alex: yes, run with triton runtime set to cutlass-optimized and qkv-fusion on. cmd below:
```
./run_bench --model rerank-3B --dims 1536 --batch 32 --kernel cutlass --quant none --region us-west-2,ap-southeast-1,eu-west-1
```
Santiago: can you paste p50/p99 latencies for a single request (per-embedding)?
Alex: p50/p95/p99 (ms) per embedding request, B=32: H100(us-west-2) 1.1/2.9/6.4, A100 2.9/7.6/18.1, CPU 42/120/340.
Maria: region delta? e.g., eu-west-1 vs us-west-2
Alex: eu-west-1 (A100) added ~8-12% hop extra: A100(us-west-2) p99 18.1ms vs eu-west-1 p99 20.5ms for same infra config.
Keiko: kernels note: cutlass + fused kv cache gave ~1.9x vs generic triton kernel for long dims (1536). For 256-d the advantage shrinks to ~1.15x.
perf-bot: auto-summary: H100 ~2.7x A100 for 1536-d @B=32; network adds ~10% in non-primary regions; cutlass kernel beneficial for >1024 dims.
Santiago: did you try quantized runs? q4f16 or int8?
Alex: yes. q4f16 on H100: throughput +18%, p99 ~ -10% latency; int8 (experimental) +30% throughput but had ~0.6% recall hit on reranker eval (R@10).
Maria: any quality regressions noted vs fp16 baseline?
Alex: reranker R@10 drop: q4f16 ~0.03% (negligible), int8 ~0.6% (we flagged); embeddings cosine sim drift <0.002 for q4f16, ~0.012 for int8.
Keiko: so int8 is risky for production rerank. q4f16 looks safe for embeddings-heavy workloads.
Santiago: capacity guidance? how many users per GPU? rough calc?
Alex: rule of thumb (1536-d, B=32): H100 ~38k embeds/s -> ~136M embeds/hr. For 1k qps application (1 embed per request) that's 3600/s -> you need ~0.095 H100 (so 11 H100s for 100k qps). For A100 ~14k -> 1 A100 handles ~50k qps equivalent.
Maria: can you sanity-check the math in doc form?
Alex: posted a small calc sheet and chart: https://redwood-infer-charts/bench/1768501234.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Keiko: kernel/runtime notes: for small batch sizes (<8) triton generic is closer; enable continuous-batching for low-latency streams.
perf-bot: attached logs: https://s3.redwood/bench/1768501234/logs.tar.gz
Santiago: thanks. action items?
Alex: 1) run stable q4f16 eval sweep across eval sets (Srep+MSMARCO) 2) run more A/B on int8 with calibration 3) capacity-table for prod regions (I'll write draft)
Maria: Sounds good. assign Alex -> Alex:@alex :thumbsup:
Santiago: ping me if int8 eval needs more heads.
Alex: will do. closing after docs are up.
